## Capabilities

- Web applications with Laravel, React, Inertia, TypeScript, and Tailwind
- Cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android with React Native and Expo
- Backend APIs, third-party integrations, authentication, and notifications
- Real-time features and AI-powered application experiences (where project scope includes them)

## Award

- Ada Lovelace — LionsGeek team award project; Ayman created the 3D avatar and integrated Moroccan Darija into teammates’ parts. Prix Coup de Cœur Jury at [IN]VISIBLE Festival 2026 (XR4Heritage, Brussels). Shown separately from the project archive.
